complete_original_wording_corrections.original_sentence_preserved: Complete BlazeAttackGoal owns MOVE/LOOK and canUse current nonnull/alive/canAttack target; inherited Goal.canContinueToUse delegates canUse. Normal selector cleanup stops an invalid current target, running wrapper gates start/stop, and everytick request selects goal tick on both shown Mob selector scheduling arms. This is normal native scheduling source, not full outer NoAI/immobile/engine guarantee.
complete_original_wording_corrections.correction: Continuation qualification only on full selector cleanup; every-tick dispatch also occurs during running-only pass without renewed alive/canAttack. Do not read the original normal cleanup language as each-tick validation.

complete_original_wording_corrections.original_sentence_preserved: When outside ranged/near qualifications, else-if lastSeen<5 may request chase; after enough noLOS ticks that local request stops, not necessarily movement/path/phase. It never clears charged or phase for range/LOS loss alone. Timer continues toward negative; regaining qualifications can immediately advance the retained phase if<=0. No extreme overflow/load/timing exploit claim.
complete_original_wording_corrections.correction: Near distanceSqr<4 with noLOS returns directly and never enters outside lastSeen<5 chase. Original outside-ranged/near qualifier is retained explicitly.

complete_original_wording_corrections.original_sentence_preserved: Charged bit is synced DATA_FLAGS_ID bit1 and own isOnFire returns that bit, not ordinary remainingFireTicks. Entity.displayFireAnimation calls virtual isOnFire and excludes spectator; dispatcher invokes renderFlame from that predicate. Charge appearance can persist across lost LOS/melee and is cleared by own normal stop/cycle end, not proof a current target is damaged or refused control.
complete_original_wording_corrections.correction: DATA_FLAGS_ID mask0x01 is lowest bit, zero-based bit0. Original “bit1” meant mask value1 and is superseded for bit indexing, never 1<<1.

complete_original_wording_corrections.original_sentence_preserved: Goal.start sets only attackStep0; it does not reset attackTime. stop clears charged bit and lastSeen0 but does not set attackTime/step/target. Same goal object reentry therefore can retain remaining attackTime while resetting step; fresh object starts Java defaults. Source boundary, not reproduced restart/save behavior or persistent NBT proof.
complete_original_wording_corrections.correction: stop preserves both step and attackTime; subsequent start resets only step. Retention across stop does not mean phase survives a later start.

dedup_decision: One shared residual attack clock multiplexes close melee writes and a retained ranged burst phase across LOS/range gaps, current-target changes and ordinary stop/reentry. Start resets step only; stop clears charge/lastSeen only; melee rewrites timer without clearing burst/charge. This whole cross-mode clock ownership is distinct from the nine selected complete old qualification/expiry/callback/ritual/Guardian LOS/Witch drink/Wither producer/Ravager delayed roar/Wither consumer owners, all retained unchanged. Projectile admission, hit/fire rollback, visual charge, stages, constants, sounds and model support add0; no exhaustive global521 novelty claim or incoming-control immunity conclusion.
